entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A soldier stripped of the title Guardian of Thraben who renounces Avacyn's church, accuses Bishop Jerren of leading the Skirsdag, and founds the Order of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A cathar leader who sits on the Lunarch Council without a vote, who betrays Thalia's heresy, then rescues her and kills his own cathars to flee Thraben.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: Odric's red-haired champion who escorts Thalia out, then helps free her and swears to follow her.

entities.name: Bishop Jerren
entities.description: A bishop who is nominal leader of the Lunarch Council and is accused of leading the Skirsdag in communion with Ormendahl.

entities.name: Quilion
entities.description: A lesser bishop who defends Jerren and calls Thalia the only heretic.

entities.name: Carlin
entities.description: A bishop who reads Thalia's letter and pales.

entities.name: Dougan
entities.description: A young cathar trained by Odric, who blocks the escape on Jerren's orders and is wounded.

entities.name: Marta
entities.description: A young cathar trained by Odric, killed by Grete in the fight.

entities.name: Haral
entities.description: An older soldier who fought zombies with Odric and is killed by him.

entities.name: Ulmach
entities.description: The Chief Inquisitor of Nephalia whose inquisition burns children at Elgaud.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon called the Profane Prince, in communion with Jerren according to Thalia.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel at the head of the church, now leading a purge; Thalia doubts whether the Helvault corrupted her.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A holy geist and legendary saint who appears beside Thalia and is patron of her order.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The holy city where the Lunarch Council sits.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral where the Lunarch Council meets and where Thalia is imprisoned.

entities.name: Elgaud
entities.description: A place in Nephalia where the inquisition has burned children.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region where the church is led by Ulmach.

entities.name: Wittal Parish
entities.description: A parish near the ruins of Estwald where Thalia says she found a witch with Jerren's letter.

entities.name: Nearheath Chapel
entities.description: A small chapel where Thalia gathers cathars and founds her order.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison that contained the demons and Avacyn before Thalia sundered it.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The council of senior bishops that commands the Church of Avacyn, with cathar leaders as advisors.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church of Innistrad that serves Avacyn and runs the inquisition.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The soldiers of Avacyn's church.

entities.name: Inquisition
entities.description: The church's inquisition, operating under the council's aegis, led by Ulmach.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A demonic cult accused by Thalia of being led by Bishop Jerren.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: A band of cathars gathered by Thalia in a small chapel to fight corrupt church and angels.

entities.name: Flight Alabaster
entities.description: A flight of angels invoked in cathar funeral rites.

events.summary: Thalia rides to Thraben Cathedral, furious after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
events.quote: The ride from the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia to Thraben Cathedral had taken days

events.summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
events.quote: We're burning children now.

events.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
events.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

events.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
events.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

events.summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
events.quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

events.summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
events.quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

events.summary: Thalia tells Grete she will fight, even against the angels if she must.
events.quote: I'm going to fight,

events.summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
events.quote: The council has removed it from you.

events.summary: Thalia accuses Bishop Jerren of communion with Ormendahl and of leading the Skirsdag.
events.quote: I bring evidence that you have been in communion with the demon Ormendahl, called the Profane Prince, and you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.

events.summary: Thalia recounts finding a witch eating a messenger's heart in Wittal parish and killing her (recounted).
events.quote: Rushing inside, we found the witch lifting the quivering heart from the corpse of a messenger

events.summary: Thalia presents a bloodstained letter bearing Jerren's seal giving instructions to the witch in the Profane Prince's name.
events.quote: The letter bears the seal and signature of none other than Bishop Jerren, giving instructions to this witch in the name of the Profane Prince!

events.summary: Several bishops refuse the letter until Carlin takes it and pales as she reads.
events.quote: Three bishops refused her as the council sat in stony silence, before Bishop Carlin took it with a quivering hand.

events.summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
events.quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

events.summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
events.quote: We are leaving here, together.

events.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
events.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

events.summary: Odric disarms and wounds Dougan, and Grete kills Marta in the fight against the eight cathars.
events.quote: Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

events.summary: Odric kills Haral, leaving all eight cathars bleeding or dying on the cathedral floor.
events.quote: The inevitable opening came, and Odric took it without thinking, slashing the man's throat open.

events.summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
events.quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

events.summary: Thalia welcomes Grete to the Order of Saint Traft in a small Nearheath chapel.
events.quote: Welcome to the Order of Saint Traft,

events.summary: The holy geist of Saint Traft appears beside Thalia.
events.quote: radiant but insubstantial, a holy geist.

events.summary: Grete kneels and pledges to follow Thalia.
events.quote: Wherever you lead.

relations.note: Old friends, though divided over the inquisition.
relations.quote: It's good to see you, old friend,

relations.note: He sits on the council without a vote.
relations.quote: I am a member of the Lunarch Council...

relations.note: He says he serves Avacyn and her church.
relations.quote: I serve Avacyn and her church.

relations.note: Called the nominal leader of the council.
relations.quote: the nominal leader of the council

relations.note: Alleged by Thalia, who accuses him of communion with Ormendahl.
relations.quote: you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.
He had trained the young man, years ago.
Marta, another young cathar he had trained.
Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

relations.note: She gathers the cathars and welcomes Grete to the order.
relations.quote: Welcome to the Order of Saint Traft,

relations.note: Thalia says he chose her as patron.
